# Lua API reference

Back to the [modding guide](index.md).

<!-- Generated by `go test ./internal/guide -update-docs` from the Lua API registry (internal/modhost/luavm); do not edit. -->

The Lua API of mod API 0.12. It may still change before 1.0. Every mod's Lua sees these tables; `bururu mod types` writes the same API as `types/bururu.d.lua` for an editor. How to use them: [When to use Lua](rules.md#when-to-use-lua), [A mod in Lua](quickstart-lua.md).

## Tables

| Table | What it holds |
|---|---|
| [`bururu`](#the-bururu-table) | Registration of handlers, this mod's state, exports between mods. |
| [`hook`](#the-hook-table) | Hook points between a game mod and its add-ons. |
| [`feel`](#the-feel-table) | Feels: one-shots, layers and motor levels. |
| [`rules`](#the-rules-table) | The data rules of the instance. |
| [`Frame`](#the-frame-on_frames-f) | The frame in on_frame: f:light(...), f:trigger(...) and the rest change it after the tables and overlays. |
| [`out`](#the-out-table) | Timed overlays of lights.json. |
| [`sensor`](#the-sensor-table) | Asks and queries to the declared sensors. |
| [`channels`](#the-channels-table) | Vocabulary channels. |
| [`data`](#the-data-table) | The mod's data tables. |
| [`status`](#the-status-table) | Live facts and toasts. |
| [`setup`](#the-setup-table) | Setup items on the Controller page. |
| [`log`](#the-log-table) | The log, under the log budget. |
| [`kit`](#the-kit-table) | General helpers. |
| [`gomath`](#the-gomath-table) | Math functions: rounding, min and max, trigonometry. |
| [`bit`](#the-bit-table) | Bit operations on integers up to 2^53. |
| [`sensors`](#the-sensors-table) | The visible snapshots of the declared sensors, by id; read-only. |
| [Table shapes](#table-shapes) | the tables the API hands out or takes: the tick context, the pad, options |

## The bururu table

Registration of handlers, this mod's state, exports between mods.

### `bururu.state`

A value of type `table`. This mod's own table for the session.

### `bururu.on`

`bururu.on(selector, fn)`

Run fn for every input the selector matches (as a rule's "on").

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `selector` | `string` | "&lt;sensor>:&lt;name>", "&lt;sensor>:\*", "&lt;sensor>:change" or "binds:action=&lt;name>" |
| `fn` | `fun(ev: Event)` | the handler |

### `bururu.facts`

`bururu.facts(fn)`

Tell Bururu at the end of each read phase whether the player is in control.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick): Facts` | returns active, menu and context |

### `bururu.before_screen`

`bururu.before_screen(fn)`

Set the screen asks before Bururu takes the screen's state.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick, active: boolean)` | the handler |

### `bururu.after_screen`

`bururu.after_screen(fn)`

Run after the screen's inputs of the tick (the fast ask).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick)` | the handler |

### `bururu.on_pad`

`bururu.on_pad(fn)`

Run at the start of the drive phase, before the actions of the tick.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick)` | the handler |

### `bururu.on_tick`

`bururu.on_tick(fn)`

Run on every active tick with haptics on; layers are set here.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick)` | the handler |

### `bururu.on_idle`

`bururu.on_idle(fn)`

Run on ticks without driving; t.reason is "idle" or "haptics_off", and "restart" once when a session restart keeps the game.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick)` | the handler |

### `bururu.before_frame`

`bururu.before_frame(fn)`

Compute state the light tables read, before the tables run.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick)` | the handler |

### `bururu.on_frame`

`bururu.on_frame(fn)`

Change the frame after the tables and overlays.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(t: Tick, f: Frame)` | the handler |

### `bururu.on_reload`

`bururu.on_reload(fn)`

Take over the state of the version a hot reload replaced.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `fun(old_state: table)` | gets a data-only copy of the old bururu.state |

### `bururu.export`

`bururu.export(name, fn)`

Offer a function to the other mods of the instance.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the export's name |
| `fn` | `function` | the function |

### `bururu.import`

`bururu.import(mod_id, name) -> fn`

A function another mod of the instance exported; it is looked up at each call.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `mod_id` | `string` | the exporting mod |
| `name` | `string` | the export's name |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `function` | calls the export |

## The hook table

Hook points between a game mod and its add-ons.

### `hook.add`

`hook.add(point, handler_id, fn)`

Attach a handler to a hook point another mod runs.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `point` | `string` | "&lt;mod>/&lt;name>@&lt;n>" |
| `handler_id` | `string` | "&lt;your mod>/&lt;name>", unique per point |
| `fn` | `fun(payload: table)` | changes the copy of the payload it gets |

### `hook.remove`

`hook.remove(point, handler_id)`

Detach a handler from a hook point.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `point` | `string` | "&lt;mod>/&lt;name>@&lt;n>" |
| `handler_id` | `string` | the id hook.add gave |

### `hook.run`

`hook.run(point, payload) -> payload`

Run one of this mod's declared hook points; returns the payload after its handlers.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `point` | `string` | "&lt;name>@&lt;n>" as the manifest declares it |
| `payload` | `table` | plain data, at most 4 deep and 256 entries |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `payload` | `table` | the payload after the handlers, or the same table when none ran |

## The feel table

Feels: one-shots, layers and motor levels.

### `feel.play`

`feel.play(name, opts)`

Play a one-shot feel, on the controller in your hands or the one opts names.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | a feel name, plain or "&lt;mod>/&lt;name>" |
| `opts` | `FeelPlayOpts?` | how it plays |

### `feel.layer`

`feel.layer(key, name, level, opts)`

Hold a continuous feel this tick at a level; a key missing next tick glides out.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | the layer key: its identity and mix order |
| `name` | `string?` | the feel; nil with opts.rumble plays on the motors only |
| `level` | `number` | 0..1 |
| `opts` | `FeelLayerOpts?` | how it plays |

### `feel.rumble`

`feel.rumble(key, rumble_key, level, opts)`

Hold a motors-only level this tick.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | the layer key |
| `rumble_key` | `string` | the rumble table entry |
| `level` | `number` | 0..1 |
| `opts` | `FeelRumbleOpts?` | side and gain |

### `feel.exists`

`feel.exists(name) -> exists`

Whether a feel of that name resolves for this mod.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | a feel name |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `exists` | `boolean` |  |

## The rules table

The data rules of the instance.

### `rules.stage`

`rules.stage(name)`

Evaluate a layer stage of the data rules now.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the stage |

## The frame (on_frame's f)

The frame in on_frame: f:light(...), f:trigger(...) and the rest change it after the tables and overlays.

### `Frame:light`

`f:light(key, bright)`

Set the lightbar to a colour of the colour table.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | the colour table key |
| `bright` | `number?` | 0..1 of the player's brightness; nil: 1 |

### `Frame:light_rgb`

`f:light_rgb(rgb, key, bright)`

Set the lightbar to an explicit colour.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `rgb` | `integer[]` | {r, g, b}, 0..255 each |
| `key` | `string?` | the key the window shows |
| `bright` | `number?` | 0..1 of the player's brightness; nil: 1 |

### `Frame:trigger`

`f:trigger(side, key)`

Set a trigger to an effect of the trigger table.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `string` | "l2", "r2" or "both" |
| `key` | `string?` | the trigger table key; nil: none |

### `Frame:trigger_raw`

`f:trigger_raw(side, mode, values)`

Set a trigger to a raw effect.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `string` | "l2", "r2" or "both" |
| `mode` | `string` | a trigger mode: OFF, FEEDBACK, WEAPON, VIBRATION, ... |
| `values` | `integer[]` | the mode's values |

### `Frame:leds`

`f:leds(count)`

Light the player LEDs.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `integer` | 0 (off) to 5 |

### `Frame:mic`

`f:mic(mode)`

Set the mic LED.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | "on", "pulse" or "off" |

### `Frame:final`

`f:final()`

No overlays this frame.

### `Frame:slot`

`f:slot(n) -> frame`

The frame of controller n (t.slots[n]), with the same methods. The tables and overlays set only the frame of the controller in your hands; another controller that gets no frame rests.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | `integer` | the slot, from 1 |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `frame` | `Frame` |  |

### `Frame:player`

`f:player(n) -> frame`

The frame of player n's controller: Controller n while the facts say two or more people play and two or more controllers are connected (a player with no controller connected gets none), else the controller in your hands.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | `integer` | the player, from 1 |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `frame` | `Frame` |  |

## The out table

Timed overlays of lights.json.

### `out.overlay`

`out.overlay(id, opts)`

Start a timed overlay of lights.json.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the overlay id |
| `opts` | `table?` | options, plain data |

### `out.overlay_stop`

`out.overlay_stop(id)`

Stop a running overlay.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the overlay id |

## The sensor table

Asks and queries to the declared sensors.

### `sensor.set`

`sensor.set(id, params)`

Ask a sensor to change its parameters (screen on, fast mode, or any setting the sensor takes).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the sensor id |
| `params` | `table` | parameters, plain data |

### `sensor.call`

`sensor.call(id, method, ...) -> result`

A one-off ask of a sensor, or a query that answers at once, such as the newest line of a log.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the sensor id |
| `method` | `string` | the method |
| `...` | `any` | its arguments, plain data |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `result` | `any` | a query's answer; nothing for an ask |

## The channels table

Vocabulary channels.

### `channels.set`

`channels.set(name, value)`

Publish a vocabulary channel.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the channel: "racing.rpm" |
| `value` | `any` | a number, boolean, string or per-wheel array |

## The data table

The mod's data tables.

### `data.get`

`data.get(name) -> table`

A data table, data/&lt;name>.json after patches; a fresh copy each call.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the table's name |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `table` | `table` |  |

## The status table

Live facts and toasts.

### `status.fact`

`status.fact(id, value)`

Set a live fact the settings schema declares (on the mod's first page).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the fact id |
| `value` | `any` | a number, boolean or string |

### `status.notice`

`status.notice(text)`

Show a toast (rate-limited).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | the words |

## The setup table

Setup items on the Controller page.

### `setup.item`

`setup.item(id, state, text)`

Set a setup item on the Controller page.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the item id |
| `state` | `string` | "ok", "warn" or "fail" |
| `text` | `string?` | the words |

## The log table

The log, under the log budget.

### `log.info`

`log.info(fmt, ...)`

Write a log line, formatted as string.format does, under the log budget.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fmt` | `string` | the line or a format |
| `...` | `any` | the format's values |

### `log.warn`

`log.warn(fmt, ...)`

Write a warning line, formatted as string.format does.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fmt` | `string` | the line or a format |
| `...` | `any` | the format's values |

### `log.once`

`log.once(key, fmt, ...)`

Write a line once per session for key.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | the line's key |
| `fmt` | `string` | the line or a format |
| `...` | `any` | the format's values |

## The kit table

General helpers.

### `kit.null`

A value of type `userdata`. The JSON null in inputs, so presence tests see a JSON null.

### `kit.fresh`

`kit.fresh(tracked, now, ms) -> fresh`

tracked.ok and now - tracked.at &lt; ms milliseconds (hud.Tracked.Fresh).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `tracked` | `table?` | {value, ok, at} |
| `now` | `number` | ns since session start |
| `ms` | `number` | the age limit |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fresh` | `boolean` |  |

### `kit.has`

`kit.has(x) -> has`

x is present: neither nil nor kit.null.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | `any` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `has` | `boolean` |  |

### `kit.blink`

`kit.blink(unix_ms, hz) -> on`

On for the first half of each period at hz (always on at 0).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `unix_ms` | `number` | t.unix_ms |
| `hz` | `number` | blinks per second |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `on` | `boolean` |  |

### `kit.breathe`

`kit.breathe(unix_ms, hz, low) -> level`

A brightness between low and 1 that swells at hz.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `unix_ms` | `number` | t.unix_ms |
| `hz` | `number` | swells per second |
| `low` | `number` | the lowest value |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `number` |  |

### `kit.seconds`

`kit.seconds(unix_ms) -> s`

unix_ms in seconds.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `unix_ms` | `number` | t.unix_ms |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `s` | `number` |  |

### `kit.mix`

`kit.mix(a, b, f) -> rgb`

From colour a to colour b as f goes from 0 to 1, rounded to whole numbers.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | `integer[]` | {r, g, b} |
| `b` | `integer[]` | {r, g, b} |
| `f` | `number` | 0..1 |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `rgb` | `integer[]` | {r, g, b} |

### `kit.clamp`

`kit.clamp(x, lo, hi) -> x`

x within lo and hi.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | `number` |  |
| `lo` | `number` |  |
| `hi` | `number` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | `number` |  |

### `kit.same`

`kit.same(a, b) -> same`

Deep equality of plain values.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | `any` |  |
| `b` | `any` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `same` | `boolean` |  |

### `kit.has_prefix`

`kit.has_prefix(s, p) -> has`

s starts with p (plain text, no patterns).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `s` | `string` |  |
| `p` | `string` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `has` | `boolean` |  |

### `kit.has_suffix`

`kit.has_suffix(s, p) -> has`

s ends with p (plain text).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `s` | `string` |  |
| `p` | `string` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|

### `kit.contains`

`kit.contains(s, sub) -> has`

s holds sub (plain text).

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `s` | `string` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|

### `kit.lower`

s in lower case.

| Parameter | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `s` | `string` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `lower` | `string` |  |

## The gomath table

Math functions: rounding, min and max, trigonometry.

### `gomath.inf`

A value of type `number`. Positive infinity.

### `gomath.nan`

A value of type `number`. Not a number.

### `gomath.pi`

A value of type `number`. Pi.

|---|---|---|
| `y` | `number` |  |

| `y` | `number` |  |

| Result | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | `number` |  |

## The sensors table

The visible snapshots of the declared sensors, by id; read-only.

### `sensors.<id>`

A value of type `table`. The visible snapshot of a declared sensor (sensors.game, sensors.status); read-only.

## Table shapes

The tables the API hands out or takes. A handler's `t` is a `Tick`; `on_frame`'s second argument is a `Frame`.

### `Tick`

The tick context every handler gets; one per VM, updated in place, read-only.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `now` | `number` | ns since session start (an exact integer) |
| `unix_ms` | `number` | wall clock ms (blinks, wobbles) |
| `dt` | `number` | drive phase: s since the last on_tick, 0.005..0.2, first 0.025 |
| `native` | `boolean` | voices render on the actuators |
| `ducked` | `table<string, boolean>` | ducked[bus] is true while a ducking shot holds that bus |
| `active` | `boolean` | true this tick when the game runs, the mod says active, and effects are not paused |
| `reason` | `string` | on_idle: "idle", "haptics_off" or "restart" |
| `gyro` | `Gyro` | Bururu's gyro aim |
| `caps` | `Caps` | what the controller in use can do |
| `slot` | `integer` | the slot of the controller in use (the one in your hands); 0 while none is connected |
| `slots` | `Slot[]` | the connected controllers: Controller n on the Controller page is t.slots[n] (walk them with for n = 1, #t.slots) |
| `pad` | `Pad` | drive phase: the pad of this tick |
| `settings` | `table` | this mod's setting values |
| `core` | `table` | Bururu's own settings, read-only: gyro_aim, haptics_strength, lightbar_brightness, poll_ms, ... |
| `words` | `table<string, string>` | backend words a mod may log (no_motion_hint, ...) |

### `Gyro`

Bururu's gyro aim as a mod may read it.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `held` | `boolean` | something holds the gyro aim |
| `aiming` | `boolean` | gyro aim is on and moving the mouse |

### `Slot`

One connected controller.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | "DualSense Edge, USB", "Xbox controller" |
| `caps` | `Caps` | what it can do |

### `Caps`

What a controller can do.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `voices` | `boolean` | wave haptics on two actuators; false for a DualSense on its cable on macOS |
| `voice_rate` | `integer` | 48000 (USB) or 3000 (Bluetooth); 0 without voices |
| `motors` | `integer` | body rumble motors |
| `impulse` | `boolean` | trigger motors |
| `adaptive` | `boolean` | adaptive trigger effects |
| `lightbar` | `boolean` | a lightbar |
| `leds` | `boolean` | player LEDs |
| `mic` | `boolean` | a mic LED |
| `motion` | `boolean` | motion input |
| `touch` | `boolean` | a touchpad |

### `Pad`

The pad of one active tick.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `boolean` | a controller is open and sends input |
| `l2` | `integer` | left trigger, 0..255 |
| `r2` | `integer` | right trigger, 0..255 |
| `held` | `table<string, boolean>` | held buttons: south east west north l1 r1 l2 r2 l3 r3 start select home touchpad mic up down left right, and their Sony and Xbox names |
| `pressed` | `table<string, boolean>` | pressed since the last tick, same names |
| `sticks` | `table<string, number>` | lx ly rx ry, -1..1 |
| `aim_dps` | `number` | how fast the pad pitches and yaws, deg/s |
| `gyro_dps` | `number[]` | deg/s: pitch, yaw, roll |
| `gyro_raw` | `integer[]` | raw angular velocity |
| `accel_raw` | `integer[]` | raw acceleration |
| `clock` | `integer` | the motion sensor clock |
| `touch` | `boolean` | a finger rests on the touchpad |
| `has_gyro` | `boolean` | the connection passes motion |
| `l2_held` | `boolean` | button pressed or analog past the threshold |
| `r2_held` | `boolean` | button pressed or analog past the threshold |

### `Event`

One input: its fields as the sensor gives them, plus these.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `at` | `number` | ns since session start |
| `live` | `boolean` | false while a file source catches up |
| `sensor` | `string` | the sensor id |
| `input` | `string` | "&lt;sensor>:&lt;name>" |
| `old` | `table?` | a snapshot change: the previous value |
| `new` | `table?` | a snapshot change: the new value |

### `Facts`

What a game mod's facts handler returns.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `active` | `boolean` | the player is in control |
| `menu` | `boolean` | a menu is open: hold the gyro if the player wants that |
| `context` | `string` | the sentence for "State: ..." and the window |
| `players` | `integer?` | how many people play now; nil is 1. With 2 or more, and two or more controllers connected, player n's feels play on Controller n; a player with no controller connected gets none |

### `FeelPlayOpts`

How a one-shot plays.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `delay_ms` | `number?` | start this much later |
| `at` | `number?` | start at this time, ns since session start |
| `side` | `string?` | "both", "left" or "right" |
| `scale` | `number?` | strength; nil is 1, 0 or less plays nothing |
| `pan` | `number?` | -1 left .. 1 right |
| `amount` | `number?` | what the feel's amount-scaled voices scale by |
| `gain` | `string?` | the gain table key; default the feel's mix.gain, else its name |
| `rumble` | `string?` | the rumble table key; default the feel's name |
| `params` | `table<string, number>?` | the feel's params |
| `slot` | `integer?` | play on controller n (t.slots[n]) only; nil: the controller in your hands |
| `player` | `integer?` | player n's feel: Controller n while the facts say two or more people play and two or more controllers are connected (a player with no controller connected gets none), else the controller in your hands |

### `FeelLayerOpts`

How a layer plays this tick.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `string?` | "both", "left" or "right" |
| `gain` | `string?` | the gain table key; default the layer key |
| `rumble` | `string\|false\|nil` | the rumble table key, false for nothing on the motors |
| `params` | `table<string, number>?` | the feel's params |
| `add` | `table<string, number>?` | added to voice fields (f0_hz, f1_hz, level, trem_hz, trem_depth, gate_hz, gate_duty, band_hz) |
| `slot` | `integer?` | as for feel.play |
| `player` | `integer?` | as for feel.play |

### `FeelRumbleOpts`

How a motors-only level plays.

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `string?` | "both", "left" or "right" |
| `gain` | `string?` | the gain table key; default the layer key |
| `slot` | `integer?` | as for feel.play |
| `player` | `integer?` | as for feel.play |

### `Frame`

on_frame's f: changes the frame of the controller in your hands after the tables and overlays (methods: light, light_rgb, trigger, trigger_raw, leds, mic, final, slot, player).
